take_homes: I don't share the agent. I share context or output, and someone has to own it and answer for it.
I start from one teammate's job and a single observable outcome, not from what I built.
A missing owner name in the people plan is the real finding. My plan needs names before it needs more prompts.

monday.move: Interview Mats (pricing working group) about how he builds the pilot-cohort brief today. Then write the outcome sentence and pick context-sharing or the scheduled output as the candidate. Pick the switch assumption to test.
monday.who: Mats, plus my CFO's analyst if I need an owner for the shared context
monday.when: Monday morning, 30 minutes with Mats, then the plan files by lunch
monday.stop_condition: Mats can't name what he does today or what would make him switch. Then I have the wrong teammate and I pick someone else.
monday.blocker: There is still no shared place for the context files, so everyone keeps their own copy. I need an owner and a location before anything can be absorbed.

misconception.why: The module says the value sits in my corrections, memory and judgement, and that adoption depends on the other person's job and an owner. Better prompts don't fix that. It never demonstrated a prompt-versus-context comparison, so I'm only shaken.

one_line: Useful on the people side, since it told me my plan was missing names, but the lecture mostly repeats the exercises and the agent never showed me anything new in my own sources.
